newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria parent 9-month operating up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria parent 9-month operating up 10 pct.

text.p: Bank Austria, the country's largest bank, posted a rise in parent operating profit on Monday in the first nine months of the year of 9.9 percent to 3.6 billion schillings ($340.3 million).
In a statement Bank Austria said the earnings were boosted by its business abroad.
Operating income climbed 4.7 percent to 13.3 billion schillings, while operating costs showed a more modest rise of 2.9 percent to 9.7 billion, compared with the year ago period.
Shareholders' equity amounted to 45.1 billion schillings in the first nine months of 1996, against 40.1 billion for the full year 1995.

Bank Austria's balance sheet was 720.2 billion schillngs to the end of September, a 6.3 percent rise on the year to December 1995. Foreign exchange activities reached 32.5 percent against 30.9 percent for the 1995 full year.
The firm said 50 branches had been closed since the merger of the Zentralsparkasse and Kommerzialbank AG and the Oesterreichischen Laenderbank AG in October 1991.
